title: Event envelope v1
description: Every event the forge_events port emits or reads. event_id is the idempotency key: sha256 of producer, type and the natural key the payload schema names (x-natural-key).

event_id.description: sha256 of producer, type and natural key; re-emitting the same fact yields the same id.

occurred_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC from the injected clock.

producer.description: The tool or role that emitted the event.

correlation_id.description: Groups the events of one run (a gate run, a train batch).
